question: Who received the prestigious Aryabhatta Award from the Astronautical Society of India (ASI) in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subba Rao Pavuluri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subba Rao Pavuluri**, the founder and Chairman & Managing Director of **Ananth Technologies Limited (ATL)**, was conferred with the prestigious **Aryabhatta Award** in 2024.
 
• The award was presented by the **Astronautical Society of India (ASI)** to recognize his outstanding lifetime contributions to the field of **astronautics** and his efforts in advancing the **Indian space program**.
 
• He has played a pivotal role in the design and manufacture of high-reliability systems for **ISRO**, contributing to numerous satellite and launch vehicle missions such as **PSLV** and **GSLV**.
 
• As a pioneer in the **private aerospace sector**, his work has been instrumental in strengthening the **domestic space industry** and supporting India's self-reliance in **space technology**.
 
• The **Aryabhatta Award** is the highest recognition in India for excellence in the field of **aerospace** and **astronautical engineering**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Astronautical Society of India (ASI)**:

 
 
• Established in **1990**, its primary objective is to promote and disseminate technical knowledge related to **astronautics** and space science within the country.
 
 
 
• **G. Satheesh Reddy**:
 
 
• A prominent Indian scientist who served as the **Chairman of the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** and received the **Aryabhatta Award** in 2015.
 
 
 
• **Dr. V.K. Saraswat**:
 
 
• An Indian scientist who served as the **Director General of DRDO** and the **Chief Scientific Advisor** to the Indian Minister of Defence; he is currently a member of **NITI Aayog**.
 
 
 
• **Dr. R.P. Shenoy**:
 
 
• A distinguished scientist known for his significant contributions to **Radar technology** in India and served as the Director of **LRDE** (Electronics and Radar Development Establishment).
